description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Puppeteer Clique
When Puppeteer Clique dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Puppeteer Clique enters, it and Stalwart Successor trigger.
Resolve the Puppeteer Clique trigger, putting a creature from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Resolve the Stalwart Successor trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Puppeteer Clique
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
